# Local inputs, outside Git

Put your two original TSX files in `original/`. Put VRAM.DAT and VRAM.IDX in
`graphics/`, or use `make import-graphics RELEASE_DIR=...`. See
[Building](../docs/BUILDING.md) for hashes and regeneration instructions.

Original games, extracted records, MSX system ROMs, MSX-DOS/Nextor kernels and
COMMAND.COM are not included in the source distribution. Do not commit them.
